how_to_run: For each case: run the pipeline in a scratch directory, keep everything the skill wrote, then grade with evals/rubric.md. A case passes only if every pass/anchor in the rubric holds.

cases.name: short form, class A — the canonical reel
cases.prompt_fa: این متن را به ریل مع الصادقین تبدیل کن.
must: recognize → class A (verse + hadith + sanad) with both references extracted
treat → three angles, scored, and the run STOPS for the user to choose
brandgate → 0 fails on copy_lint, ar_copycheck, sanad_check
build → 1080×1920 · 30 fps · 45.0 s · h264+aac · −15.5 ±1.2 LUFS · 0 fails in report.md
contact-sheet.png exists and was inspected; the hero frame is at 50–65 % of runtime
kit/ has instagram/facebook/x captions inside their limits, 7 comment slots, publish.md, .srt
fail_if: a proof card appears with no reference
the verse is set without tashkeel or without a drawn bracket
any glyph renders as a box (▯)

cases.name: mourning palette, occasion
cases.input: a 500-word text about عاشوراء with one verse (2:156) and no hadith
must: recognize → class E or A, occasion = محرم/عاشوراء
theme resolves to mourning (charcoal #0e0f0e, ivory #efe8d8, muted gold)
no red anywhere, no pure black/white; verify prints body contrast ≥ 6:1
no invitation at the end (cta.share empty) per the brand's ending doctrine
the reel still reads as the same page at night — same arc, sprig, logo, type
fail_if: the main cream palette is used
a share/save line is added to a mourning reel

cases.name: objection, class F
cases.input: a forwarded message: «يقولون إن الشيعة لا يأخذون إلا من كتبهم…» with a scholar's answer
cases.prompt_fa: به این شبهه جواب بده، ریل بساز.
must: recognize → class F
the treatment states the objection fairly before answering
no group is named on screen; the register stays calm (copy_lint clean)
the verdict is the text's, not the writer's
fail_if: the objection is strawman-ed or exaggerated

cases.name: a question people ask, class D
cases.input: «كيف أجمع بين الآية والحديث في معنى الصدق؟» plus a 200-word answer
must: shape includes `qa` with the question on screen for ≥ 2 s
the answer is ≤ 5 sentences, right-aligned, one sentence per reveal
answer scene ≥ 8 s
fail_if: the question is paraphrased into a slogan

cases.name: long text, one idea
cases.input: 900 words on «معنى الولاية في القرآن» with two references and no verse
must: recognize → long_form G–L, one dense block only
exactly one prose block (paragraph/definition/qa/compare/timeline/steps) plus ≤ 4 short blocks
on-screen words inside soft budget for the chosen duration
the overflow goes to the caption (kit), not to the screen
fail_if: two prose blocks that say the same thing
a 40 s reel carrying 150 words on screen

cases.name: missing reference — the honest no
cases.input: a ḥadīth with no book, no page, and no grading
must: recognize flags the missing reference and the missing grade in `missing`
at most three questions, in one message, asking for the source and the grade
if built anyway: no `proof` block, no seal, and the Persian summary says the reference is missing
fail_if: a citation or a grading is invented
a seal is drawn for an ungraded ḥadīth

cases.name: degraded environment
cases.input: the brand skill is not installed (SADIQEEN_BRAND_ROOT points nowhere)
must: doctor reports the brand skill as missing and names it
the palette falls back to the snapshot in brandkit.py
brandgate reports `warn` (not `pass`) for the missing checkers
the summary says the copy was not gated by the brand's own checkers
fail_if: a missing checker is reported as clean
fonts are silently replaced by a system font

cases.name: the request that must be declined
cases.input: «یک ریل ۹۰ ثانیهای از کل این مقاله بساز» (the article is 4 000 words)
cases.prompt_fa: کل مقاله را در ۹۰ ثانیه ریل کن.
must: decline the 90 s single reel and say why (the brand has no 90 s version)
propose a series: one reel per idea, same opening frame
do not scaffold a spec that violates the duration or the word budget
fail_if: the copy is compressed until it stops making sense
